title: Unlimited Easynews + Unlimited Tweaknews US$25.05 (~A$35.66) for 15 Months @ Newshosting
body:
Deal: Unlimited Easynews + Unlimited Tweaknews US$25.05 (~A$35.66) for 15 Months @ Newshosting

[redfox] This offer also stacks if you purchase using the special offer link multiple times.
[buffalo bill] Awesome. So thats stacking over existing subs too?
[FLICKIT] I stacked this 3 times last year, no complaints. (to 08/05/2029)
I also jumped on a 5year NzbGeek indexer deal, $30usd=$48aud, no complaints, that's likely to come up again this year.
Edit: the free Privado VPN that comes with Newshosting works fine, I use it on a PC (set to San Jose USA) to avoid the Aussie age restrictions on some sites…
[SickDmith] Looks like the only way to find the end of current subscription is to find the latest invoice and check there.
[FLICKIT] Yep, it's not easy, lol… The "Update your Payment" tab, then "invoices" down the bottom, then look at the newest invoice…
[jonathonsunshine] I've used a port of NZBGet for Android years ago. It would break if it wasn't the foreground app nut it still worked otherwise.
[whyisave] Major credit cards accepted, as well as Paypal is accepted.
[Wilburre] Doesn't matter but if you've got a fee free card you'll save a buck as they charge in USD and PayPal conversion rate is shocking.
[FLICKIT] Paypal, then go into your Paypal settings and cancel the recurring payment.
[Wilburre] Oh it's that time of year again already? Better re-up.
[2keane] Also tip if you want to see when your subscription ends, go to payments > invoices and the open it. Should have the date from and to.
Stacked up a couple so getting me to 2029
[eecchhoo] Have been with them for ages on $20 yearly plan. Pretty good for the price
[riklarkin] Anyone know how to stack multiple years, since when I click the link again, it takes me to my configuration page.
[FLICKIT] Log out, then click the deal link (from memory)
[tof] Even after logging out, the link shows my connection settings rather than the payment page.
I had to open the link in an incognito window and login. Managed to get 1 stack, might go for another to take me into 2030.
[riklarkin] Ok I had to delete the cookies too, then when I clicked the deal it said my username was already in use - please login - so that is the way to do it.
[Lord Ra] Am I that old if I have to ask what this even is /means?
[Mechz] Usenet has been around almost as long as the internet has.
[Mechz] I had Usenet for years but could nevet really get much value out of it. How do you easily browse new uploads?
[Smachiavelli] Be careful and check your invoices.
1st invoice applied correctly and extended the expiry date.
2nd invoice applied the 15 months to the current date.
Submitting an enquiry now, but their "Create a New Ticket" form is fuxored and keeps on coming up with "your session has expired" on submission on three different browsers
[FLICKIT] If you have any issues try messaging the rep on Reddit, last year they were very responsive..
